newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE SEEN DOWN AFTER SIX-SESSION RISE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE SEEN DOWN AFTER SIX-SESSION RISE.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall on Friday on the back of Thursday's strong selling after price fixing, returning to their general horizontal trend after a six-session recovery from earlier losses.
Analysts said the recent outperformance by small-cap stocks did not augur significant growth next week.

They said copper firm KGHM, which started trade on Thursday a surprising 11.9 percent above its institutional investor issue price, might still have room to grow from demand by foreign investors seeking a new large-cap Polish industrial.
On Thursday the bourse suspended trade in electrode maker ZEW for an indefinite period of time due to the flooding that afflicted its plant in Raciborz, southern Poland.
